text: Fair challenge. I described your rounds as if each decision was already recorded. It isn’t, and it doesn’t need to be.
Tojo adds the recording as a new layer. Your hospital only shares what it already keeps.

sheets.title: Voice notes on the round
sheets.text: You told me your doctors don’t use voice notes. A new habit on a busy round would not last.

sheets.title: Type every summary at night
sheets.text: Moving the typing to the night only moves the queue. Somebody still types every summary.

sheets.title: Wait for new hospital software
sheets.text: New software takes months to choose and set up. The trial can start in weeks without it.

sheets.title: A one-tap form, and notes you keep
sheets.text: One tap on the ward phone for each decision. Everything else is drafted from what your software already holds.
